subject: Companies Registry Notice for Harbour Light (Asia) Limited
body:
Dear Mr Ben Ho,

A letter has arrived for Harbour Light (Asia) Limited from the Companies Registry. It is a reminder regarding the overdue delivery of the 2026 Annual Return (Form NAR1), requiring you to deliver the annual return together with the appropriate fee without delay.

A scan of the letter is attached for your reference. Please let us know if you would like our assistance in preparing and filing the return.

Best regards,
XYZ CPA
